title: geum aleppicum var. strictum
intro: Geum aleppicum var. strictum, commonly known as Strict Yellow Avens, is a perennial plant species within the rose family (Rosaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional herbalism and folk medicine. The health benefits of Geum aleppicum var. strictum include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve menstrual cramps, and act as a diuretic, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids.
